summary: Collector road between two roundabouts, no parked cars or parking lane.
reasons: No bay or pull-in off the lane

drivers.seclusion: Bush and a drainage gully on the north side; homes 45 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbs run straight into landscaped banks; no room to pull fully out of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through route with moving cars; both kerbs empty.
drivers.convention: No parking convention; no vehicles stopped along this stretch.

flags: Low-lying: creek or gully 17 m away
Steep grade in the DEM around the verge, up to 21%
sun_shade: Open road; bush on the north side gives some morning shade.
